summary: Additively include current availableStock for the hold's SKU on authorized GET /reservations/{holdId} success while keeping holdId, sku, quantity, and expiresAt; preserve UnauthorizedError and PreconditionError failure channels with no stock or hold mutation; extend OpenAPI, UML OCL, and Vitest additively without breaking prior reserve/release/expire/lookup behaviors beyond the new field.
goal: Authorized opaque principals looking up a visible soft-hold by id receive existing hold details plus current availableStock for that hold's SKU without mutation; unauthorized and missing/not-visible paths keep named UnauthorizedError / PreconditionError with no mutation; OpenAPI, OCL, and Vitest make the additive field and preserved error channels machine-checkable.
background: Follow-on to done changes add-reservation-lookup and initial-reservation. Authorized get-by-id already returns hold details but not current available stock for the hold's SKU. Demand, named errors, inherited TypeScript/Node + OpenAPI + OCL + Vitest stack, and out-of-scope themes were settled in Change Context. Knowledge consult found no durable knowledge nodes yet.

in_scope.text: WHEN an authorized opaque principal looks up an existing visible soft-hold by id THEN THE reservation service SHALL return holdId, sku, quantity, expiresAt, and current availableStock for that hold's SKU without mutating stock or holds
IF the soft-hold does not exist or is not visible THEN THE reservation service SHALL fail lookup with PreconditionError and leave stock and holds unchanged
IF the caller is unauthorized THEN THE reservation service SHALL fail lookup with UnauthorizedError and leave stock and holds unchanged
Additive OpenAPI change: LookupResponse keeps holdId, sku, quantity, expiresAt and adds availableStock; prior reserve/release/expire/lookup operations remain
Module-level UML OCL with derived Vitest that make authorized lookup success including availableStock and named UnauthorizedError / PreconditionError failures checkable

out_of_scope.text: Multi-warehouse routing or cross-location inventory allocation
Full IAM product (SSO, OAuth UI, role admin) beyond opaque-principal authorize/deny for this sample
Notifications (email, push, webhooks) about holds or expiry
Backorders, waitlists, or deferred fulfillment beyond hard-fail when stock is below request
Durable shared persistence across process restarts beyond in-process stock and holds
Formal methods (e.g. TLA+) for concurrent hold races or distributed consistency
TTL extend or renewal of an existing soft-hold
List-by-SKU, aggregates, or other multi-hold query surfaces beyond get-by-id
Rewriting or breaking prior reserve/release/expire/lookup behaviors beyond the additive availableStock field on lookup success
A separate stock-query endpoint; availableStock is additive on existing lookup success only

assumptions: Prior Features at requirements/reservation.feature and requirements/reservation-lookup.feature remain in force; this change does not rewrite reserve/release/expire Scenarios and only extends lookup acceptance for availableStock
AuthZ for lookup continues the existing opaque-principal allow/deny pattern; no new IAM model
availableStock means current available stock for the hold's SKU, consistent with reserve-success semantics already used in this sample
Missing and not-visible holds share PreconditionError; unauthorized uses UnauthorizedError
Stock and holds remain process-local / in-memory; no new persistence model
